description: #61, #1039: Robin added a Retry budget task with no issue in its `issue` cell, in a workspace whose block names a backlog, and asks whether it is ready for a worker. The coordinator validates the row with `chief-of-stuff worker --check --root . --task 'Retry budget'`, a read-only call that needs no tree, needs no `--cwd`, creates no worktree and starts nothing, and tells Robin the refusal: the task names no issue. The other task, Security audit, carries its issue and passes the same check. Every grader quotes the one sentence that sends a new row to `worker --check`: Before proposing a new task for dispatch, validate its Tasks row with `chief-of-stuff worker --check --root . --task <name>`, which needs no `--cwd`, makes no worktree and starts nothing; add `--name <session>` when the task is a standing row and `--one-shot` for a one-shot task; when it prints `refused: <why>`, tell the user that refusal and do not propose the task.
prompt: I just added the Retry budget task to today's tracker. Is it ready to hand to a worker?
